meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 shadcn 组件和项目，执行添加、搜索、修复、调试及样式组合等操作。提供项目上下文、组件文档和使用示例，确保遵循正确规范。
howto.when: 当用户提及 shadcn/ui、组件注册表、预设代码，或要求运行 shadcn init、创建/切换预设时触发。适用于含 components.json 的项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage shadcn components and projects, including adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI. It provides project context, component docs, and usage examples, ensuring correct CLI commands and component conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions shadcn/ui, component registries, preset codes, or requests actions like "shadcn init", creating an app with a preset, or switching presets. Also applies to any project with a components.json file.
